evaluation.overall_comment: The translation effectively captures the scientific content and conversational tone of the original podcast script, making it highly accessible to Indonesian readers. It succeeds in preserving narrative flow, technical frameworks, and philosophical nuances without omission. Primary areas for improvement include standardizing wave optics terminology (fringes -> pita/garis interferensi, evanescent -> evanesen), correcting non-idiomatic phrasing ('mapan' -> ditegakkan/diterima secara luas), and fixing a minor speaker attribution glitch. With targeted proofreading for scientific Indonesian conventions, this translation would meet professional publication standards in science communication. Overall, it is a solid, informative, and structurally sound translation that balances accessibility with academic integrity.
